TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: LEAST( IIF(ISNULL(LAST_BILLING_DATE), 9999, DATE_DIFF(SESSSTARTTIME, LAST_BILLING_DATE, 'D')), IIF(ISNULL(LAST_TICKET_DATE), 9999, DATE_DIFF(SESSSTARTTIME, LAST_TICKET_DATE, 'D')) )
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONTACT

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CUSTOMERS, 1 AS DUMMY_LKP FROM DIM_CUSTOMER

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: ROUND( LEAST(100, -- 1. Outstanding Penalty (Max 25) IIF(IIF(ISNULL(TOTAL_REVENUE), 0, TOTAL_REVENUE) > 0, LEAST(25, (IIF(ISNULL(TOTAL_OUTSTANDING), 0, TOTAL_OUTSTANDING) / TOTAL_REVENUE) * 30), 0) + -- 2. Satisfaction Penalty (Max 25) IIF(IIF(ISNULL(AVG_SATISFACTION), 5, AVG_SATISFACTION) < 4, LEAST(25, (5 - IIF(ISNULL(AVG_SATISFACTION), 5, AVG_SATISFACTION)) * 8.33), 0) + -- 3. Complaint Penalty (Max 25) LEAST(25, IIF(ISNULL(COMPLAINT_COUNT), 0, COMPLAINT_COUNT) * 5) + -- 4. Escalation Penalty (Max 25) LEAST(25, IIF(ISNULL(ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT), 0, ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT) * 12.5) ), 2)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_RISK_SCORE

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
IIF( IIF(ISNULL(ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT), 0, ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT) >= 3 OR (IIF(ISNULL(OPEN_TICKET_COUNT), 0, OPEN_TICKET_COUNT) >= 2 AND v_RISK_SCORE >= 63.25), 'CRITICAL',
IIF( VALUE_SCORE >= 82.83 AND (IIF(ISNULL(AVG_SATISFACTION), 5, AVG_SATISFACTION) <= 3.0 OR v_RISK_SCORE >= 52.49) AND IIF(ISNULL(ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT), 0, ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT) < 3 AND IIF(ISNULL(OPEN_TICKET_COUNT), 0, OPEN_TICKET_COUNT) < 2, 'HIGH_VALUE_AT_RISK',
IIF( IIF(ISNULL(OPEN_TICKET_COUNT), 0, OPEN_TICKET_COUNT) >= 2 OR v_RISK_SCORE >= 45 OR IIF(ISNULL(COMPLAINT_COUNT), 0, COMPLAINT_COUNT) >= 4, 'MONITOR',
IIF( VALUE_SCORE >= 75 AND v_RISK_SCORE < 26.66 AND IIF(ISNULL(AVG_SATISFACTION), 5, AVG_SATISFACTION) >= 3.5 AND IIF(ISNULL(OPEN_TICKET_COUNT), 0, OPEN_TICKET_COUNT) = 0 AND IIF(ISNULL(COMPLAINT_COUNT), 0, COMPLAINT_COUNT) <= 2, 'HIGH_VALUE_STABLE',
IIF( IIF(ISNULL(ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT), 0, ESCALATED_TICKET_COUNT) = 0 AND IIF(ISNULL(AVG_SATISFACTION), 5, AVG_SATISFACTION) > 3.5, 'LOW_PRIORITY',
'MONITOR' )))))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_RETENTION_PRIORITY

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
IIF( v_RETENTION_PRIORITY = 'CRITICAL', 'URGENT: Retention call - recurring ' || IIF(ISNULL(ISSUE_TYPE), 'general', ISSUE_TYPE) || ' issues + review balance',
IIF( v_RETENTION_PRIORITY = 'HIGH_VALUE_AT_RISK', 'VIP Outreach: Proactive satisfaction check - low CSAT on high-value account',
IIF( v_RETENTION_PRIORITY = 'MONITOR', 'Monitor next cycle - recurring ' || IIF(ISNULL(ISSUE_TYPE), 'general', ISSUE_TYPE) || ' complaints',
IIF( v_RETENTION_PRIORITY = 'HIGH_VALUE_STABLE', 'Proactive loyalty offer - valued customer, monitor ' || IIF(ISNULL(ISSUE_TYPE), 'account', ISSUE_TYPE),
'No action needed - stable low-risk customer' ))))
